acceptance_criteria: All 5 named tests pass; cargo test -p jmap-mail-server --features sieve passes; cargo clippy --features sieve -- -D warnings passes
description:
Implement handle_sieve_get in src/sieve.rs (SieveScript/get handler).

WHAT: Standard RFC 8620 §5.1 /get handler for SieveScript objects.

ALGORITHM:
1. Parse args: extract account_id via extract_account_id(&args)?. Extract optional ids (Option<Vec<Id>>) and properties (Option<Vec<String>>) from the Value::Object.
2. account_exists check (exact pattern from mdn.rs):
   if !backend.account_exists(&account_id).await.map_err(|e| JmapError::server_fail(e.to_string()))? { return Err(JmapError::account_not_found()); }
3. Fetch scripts: backend.get_objects::<SieveScript>(&account_id, ids.as_deref(), None).await → (list, not_found)
4. Property filtering: if properties is Some, build HashSet<&str> and call filter_properties(&serialized_obj, &prop_set) for each object. id MUST always be included (RFC 8620 §5.1).
5. Get state: backend.get_state::<SieveScript>(&account_id).await
6. Build response JSON:
   json!({ "accountId": account_id.as_ref(), "state": state.as_ref(), "list": list_json, "notFound": not_found_json })
   where not_found_json is [] not null when empty (RFC 8620 §5.1 says notFound MUST be present).
7. Return Ok((resp, vec![]))

DEFENSIVE RULES:
- No .unwrap() or .expect() in production code
- id MUST always be included even if not in properties filter (RFC 8620 §5.1)
- not_found is [] not null (RFC 8620 §5.1 specification)
- Return server_fail for storage errors, accountNotFound for unknown accountId

AGENT TEAM: Implementer + Tester (Tester derives expected values from spec §2.3 JSON example, not from implementation)

TESTS:
- sieve_get_all_returns_list: insert 2 scripts into MemoryBackend, call handle_sieve_get with no ids, verify list has 2 entries with correct fields (oracle: spec §2.3 example 2 shape)
- sieve_get_by_id: fetch one script by id, verify all four fields
- sieve_get_not_found: fetch nonexistent id, appears in notFound not list
- sieve_get_unknown_account: accountNotFound JmapError
- sieve_get_property_filter: request only ["name", "isActive"], verify id still present and blobId absent
design:
Shape: async fn handle_sieve_get<B: SieveBackend>(backend: &B, args: Value) -> Result<Value, JmapError>

Parse: account_id (required), ids (optional — null means fetch all), properties (optional — subset of SieveScript fields).

Delegate to backend.get_sieve_scripts(account_id, ids.as_deref()).

Build response: { accountId, state, list: [...], notFound: [...] }.

Property filtering: if properties is Some, strip unrequested fields from each object. If properties is None, return all fields. id is always included (RFC 8620 §5.1).

Error path: unknown accountId → accountNotFound. Invalid id format → treat as notFound (not an error).

Spec ref: draft-ietf-jmap-sieve-22 §2.3, RFC 8620 §5.1.
